transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the solvent-cleaning cell ready to resume work Monday morning. As we all know, there's a mobile exhaust fan available in the plant that we can position at the cell's temporary duct connection. The existing exhaust has been adequate for normal cleaning work, but the temporary fan would give us additional capture during the planned solvent-cleaning campaign. Before I authorize anything, our Monday-start routine requires maintenance and environmental health and safety to review the setup first. So let's hear from both teams -- can maintenance and EHS review the fan setup so we can get this recorded and cleared for Monday?
